description: WikiFX is a third-party financial information platform specializing in the global foreign exchange (Forex) industry. It aggregates and verifies official data from over 60 regulatory authorities worldwide. The platform features a scoring system that evaluates brokers across five key dimensions: Regulation, License, Risk Control, Software, and Business. The final results will be presented in the form of a score.
